plantedBugs.description: Inline style object passed to style prop — creates a new object every render, causing unnecessary re-renders if parent is pure. Should use CSS class or memoized style.
No accessibility — div with onClick is not keyboard-focusable. Should be a button or have role="button" + tabIndex + keydown handler.
Interface defined inline in same file — fine for small components but Candidate type should be imported from shared types.
